title: The recruiter's private assessment of the candidate leaks to the candidate's own browser via /connect
expected: A candidate taking the AI voice interview should never see the interviewer's internal read on their weaknesses/gaps.
got: Candidate-mode interview sessions store an `instructions` string and `run_of_show_json` that embed the recruiter's private assessment annotations — e.g. 'Test automation fundamentals (missing must-have)', 'Motivation & QA-vs-backend fit (aspiration mismatch)', 'Facilitation (must-have, no evidence on file)', 'claim: 8 skills, largely self-taught', 'provenance: coursework only'. `POST /api/interview/connect` returns BOTH `instructions` and `groundedPrompt` (= instructions for candidate mode) in its JSON response body, which is received by the candidate's own browser: `VoiceInterview.tsx:548` reads `data.groundedPrompt` and passes it to ElevenLabs as a client-side prompt override. Any candidate opening their browser Network tab on /interview/[token] reads exactly how the recruiter has pre-judged their gaps.
evidence: data/kp.sqlite interview_sessions.instructions + run_of_show_json (candidate-mode rows tk-amdk8dz9dl4gx44j9jg9, tk-97rg4cpvm048czkxhozl, tk-rry9eh2pfg3z4uhhuo3o carry the assessment annotations verbatim)
scope_note: Wire capture was not force-minted (would consume an ElevenLabs signed-url mint + flip a candidate fixture to in_progress); confirmed via the response-body construction + the client assignment + the stored annotation data, which is conclusive.
suggested_acceptance: The candidate-facing prompt must be a candidate-safe projection: topics without the internal gap/provenance/mismatch tags. Split the interviewer's run-of-show (internal) from the agent prompt (candidate-visible).

title: Reach out on an analysis-sourced candidate 400s AND still silently files them at Screened
expected: Reaching out to a rediscovered CV-analysis candidate either sends or fails cleanly with no side effect.
got: `POST /api/jobs/[id]/candidates/outreach` first creates the pipeline entry at stage Screened (outreach/route.ts:43-54), THEN runs the automation. The automation resolves the candidate via `getProfileRecord(entry.candidateId)` (a `profiles`-table read), but an analysis-sourced candidate's id is an analysis slug with no v2 profile row → `AutomationError('candidate profile not found', 400)` at automation-run.ts:93. The candidate is left filed at Screened despite the outreach never drafting or sending.
evidence: app/_lib/candidate-pool.ts:57-63 (analysis-sourced pool entries come from listAnalysisRecords, not the profiles table)
scope_note: Confirmed via code chain (not force-run to avoid a real pipeline-entry mutation + Claude CLI spend on a non-priority journey). Mirrors L1 SR-L1-005.
suggested_acceptance: Either support drafting from an analysis record, or validate the candidate has a draftable profile BEFORE creating the Screened entry (fail with no side effect).

title: Outreach draft resolves the job from the static seed file, not the DB → 404 on in-app-created roles
expected: Reach out works for any role in the workspace, including roles created in-app.
got: The outreach route resolves the job from the DB (getJob) so the entry is created, but the downstream draft (runAutomationTask('outreach') → automation_cli.py → matching.py) loads the job from the static seed corpus file. An in-app-created role (id like `jd-dhbye8rf`, present in the DB, absent from the seed file) 404s inside the draft. A live repro was deliberately not run (real mutation + Claude CLI spend on a non-priority journey); the code chain is the evidence.
evidence: data/kp.sqlite jobs has an in-app role id `jd-dhbye8rf` (non-seed style) alongside seed job-000..job-100
scope_note: Carried forward from L1 SR-L1-004; verdict 'uncertain' because the live 404 was not force-reproduced. Code chain strongly supports it.
suggested_acceptance: The draft must resolve the job from the same authoritative DB record the route already used, not the seed file.
